experiments.title: Hanging vs ground pendulum
experiments.question: How much harder is the original ground setup than a freely hanging pendulum?

experiments.title: Does the model learn the floor?
experiments.question: In the ground setup, do predicted rods respect the floor, and are contact steps the hard part?

experiments.title: More pendulums vs longer chains
experiments.question: Is it the size of the state (D) or the coupling between joints that makes prediction hard?

experiments.title: Flow matching vs regression, change vs next state
experiments.question: Which model and which prediction target work best on the hanging setup?

experiments.title: Telling the model gravity
experiments.question: When does it matter whether the model is told the gravity of a clip?

experiments.title: Gravities outside the training range
experiments.question: Does a model trained on gravity 4-15 work at gravity 2, 20 or 25?

experiments.title: Joint damping
experiments.question: Does friction that varies between clips hurt, and does telling the model fix it?

experiments.title: Past states as context
experiments.question: Do 2-5 past states help, and when?

experiments.title: Random nuisance tokens
experiments.question: Does the model ignore meaningless random inputs, or learn from them?

experiments.title: Other worlds
experiments.question: How do springs, cart-poles and bouncing balls compare to the hanging pendulum at the same D?

experiments.title: Scaling the state: 16 to 128 dimensions
experiments.question: How does the model cope as the state grows from D = 16 to 128, with independent joints and with coupled ones?

experiments.title: Scaling to 1024 dimensions: one big network vs one network per unit
experiments.question: How far can the state grow before the model breaks, and does cutting it into units help?

experiments.title: Training longer: 60, 300 and 1000 epochs
experiments.question: Does more training help, and when does the model start to memorise?

experiments.title: Training longer, flat vs per unit
experiments.question: Does the per-unit network also memorise when trained longer, or only the flat one?

experiments.title: Telling the model each pendulum's length and mass
experiments.question: Which physical parameters does the model need to be told, and which can it work out itself?

experiments.title: Noise levels
experiments.question: How do the size of the flow-matching start noise and noise on the input states affect the model?

experiments.title: Ground pendulums: telling the model rod lengths and masses
experiments.question: With rods of different length on the floor, does telling the model the lengths and masses help it respect the floor?
